# Code of conduct

Be considerate and respectful in issues, pull requests, reviews and
discussions. Disagree with ideas, not with people. Assume good faith. Keep it
on topic.

Not acceptable: harassment, insults, discriminatory remarks, publishing
someone's private information, or sustained disruption. The maintainer may
edit, remove or lock contributions that cross that line, and may block
repeat offenders.

To report something, write to the maintainer at the e-mail address on the
GitHub profile, or open a private report through GitHub. Reports are handled
in confidence. This text follows the spirit of the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
